text.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
text.faq.a1: You share your medical reports, we identify suitable specialists and hospitals, you receive treatment and cost options, and we coordinate travel, admission and follow-up.
text.faq.q2: How do I choose the right hospital?
text.faq.a2: Your coordinator matches your condition to hospitals with the relevant specialty programme, then presents the options with their differences explained.
text.faq.a3: Cost depends on the procedure, hospital, room category and length of stay. We provide an estimated range first, then an itemised quote from the hospital.
text.faq.q4: Can you help with medical visas?
text.faq.a4: Yes. We provide the hospital invitation documents required for a medical visa and guide you through the application steps.
text.faq.q5: How long do I need to stay?
text.faq.a5: This varies by procedure. Your treatment plan will state the expected hospital stay and the recommended recovery period before flying home.
text.faq.q6: Can I speak with the doctor before travelling?
text.faq.a6: Yes. A video consultation with the treating specialist can be arranged before you commit to travel.
text.faq.q7: Can I upload my medical reports?
text.faq.a7: Yes, through the form on this page. Reports help the medical team give a more accurate assessment.
text.faq.a8: You receive discharge documents, a follow-up schedule and a point of contact for questions after you return home.
text.faq.a9: Yes. Airport transfers, local transport and accommodation near the hospital are part of the coordination service.
text.faq.q10: How do I get a treatment estimate?
text.faq.a10: Submit the consultation form with your reports and preferred treatment. Estimates are ranges, not guaranteed prices.
